title: Settlement Memo: Builder Extended Rate Lock Fees and Charges at Funding or End
content:
A Builder Extended Rate Lock ends either at funding or without funding. The upfront fee held by Calloway Home Mortgage and the lock charges owed are settled as follows.

## At funding

At funding the upfront fee is credited to the buyer where the term credits the fee at closing, and every unwaived charge is collected.

## When the lock ends without funding

The upfront fee follows the reason the purchase agreement or the lock ended:

| Reason | Upfront fee |
|---|---|
| Rescission of the purchase agreement | The term's rescission refund percent is refunded |
| Cancellation for builder delay | All of it is refunded where the term refunds the fee on builder delay |
| Financing denial | The term's financing denial refund percent is refunded |
| Withdrawal by the buyer, or any other buyer cancellation | Forfeited where the term forfeits the fee on withdrawal |

- A partial refund is rounded half up to the cent, and the remainder is forfeited with reason loan denial remainder.
- Refunds are issued within the term's refund processing business days.
- Unpaid charges on a lock that ends without funding are written off with it and are not collected.
- A withdrawal by the buyer forfeits the fee with reason buyer withdrawal.

## Financing denial worked figures (hypothetical)

| Upfront fee held | Refund percent | Refund (rounded half up to the cent) | Forfeited as loan denial remainder |
|---|---|---|---|
| USD 1250.00 | 50 | USD 625.00 | USD 625.00 |
| USD 1333.33 | 25 | 333.3325, so USD 333.33 | USD 1000.00 |
| USD 2000.00 | 100 | USD 2000.00 | none |

The refund is the refund percent of the upfront fee held; the forfeited remainder is the fee held less the refund.
